cross_row_audit.rationale: Each structure contributes one independent row with a unique identifier and disjoint installation-date cohort windows.

limitations: Current-vintage retrospective snapshot: the table is a current BSEE record, not a historical 1986-2000 installation-time snapshot.
Static attributes may have been revised after installation; historical availability at prediction time is assumed, not verified.
No full-row availability ledger; training labels use later REMOVAL_DATE values and training label timing is unverified.
INSTALL_DATE month/day precision is weak; year-only records become January 1 and install_month is coarse.
Fixed-horizon censoring: structures still present at the 25-year cutoff are labeled 0 even if removed later.
REMOVAL_DATE records structure removal, not necessarily full site clearance, well plugging or all decommissioning obligations.
Exact raw archive member name and header vocabulary were not present in the supplied evidence; construction resolves them by header matching and fails with observed evidence if absent.
SURF_N_S_DIST and SURF_E_W_DIST units are assumed feet from the field description.
The current extract may contain errors; BSEE states the data are not a legal or navigational document.
U.S. federal Gulf of Mexico OCS structures only; no transferability to other regions.

selection.evidence: Cohort membership uses INSTALL_DATE 1986-01-01 through 2000-12-31 and installation-time or static attributes. REMOVAL_DATE is used to exclude impossible removal-before-installation records and to define the fixed-horizon label; it otherwise does not select the cohort.

task.outcome_horizon: 25 calendar years after installation; cohort cutoffs fall from 2011-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
task.population: Platform structures with INSTALL_DATE from 1986-01-01 through 2000-12-31, AUTHORITY_TYPE of OCS Lease, nonmissing positive WATER_DEPTH, nonmissing STRUC_TYPE_CODE, valid latitude and longitude, nonempty BLOCK_NUMBER, a nonempty structure identifier, and a fully observed 25-year follow-up against the 2026 current-vintage snapshot; one row per structure. Exclude records whose REMOVAL_DATE precedes INSTALL_DATE.
task.prediction_time: At INSTALL_DATE; when only the installation year is reliable, January 1 of the reported installation year.
task.question: Will a newly installed offshore oil and gas structure in federal Gulf of Mexico waters be removed from the Outer Continental Shelf within 25 years of installation?
task.simple_references: Majority class; base rate by installation year; base rate by structure type, OCS area and district; train-only calendar and identity controls. Persistence score is not applicable because each structure appears once.
task.split_policy: Fixed chronological splits by installation date: train 1986-01-01 through 1990-12-31; evaluation 1991-01-01 through 1995-12-31; holdout 1996-01-01 through 2000-12-31. The 25-year outcome windows are disjoint.
task.usefulness: Decommissioning timing is a major marine-infrastructure and financial-assurance question. The target is a future removal event within a fixed horizon and cannot be copied from a feature available at installation; the model must combine water depth, structure type, location and installation calendar controls.

prediction_instant.citation: INSTALL_DATE as recorded in the current BSEE extract; no historical availability ledger was supplied.

row_selection.rule: Keep records whose INSTALL_DATE falls in the half-open 1986-01-01 through 2001-01-01 window, whose AUTHORITY_TYPE is OCS Lease, and which have nonmissing positive WATER_DEPTH, nonmissing STRUC_TYPE_CODE, valid latitude and longitude, nonempty BLOCK_NUMBER and a nonempty structure identifier. Exclude records whose REMOVAL_DATE precedes INSTALL_DATE as an integrity rule. REMOVAL_DATE otherwise defines the label and does not select the cohort.
